item.description:
Offers classic Jenga game play with a cool Frozen twist, as one or more players remove ice blocks, and then use them to build Elsa's ice palace.
In true Jenga fashion, players carefully remove and stack blocks, but this version of the game has a few additions. The ice wall must be set up with the color-coded blocks in a specific order. Players then roll a die to determine which color piece they need to remove. Instead of using their hands, players must use the snowflake wand to remove the blocks. After a block is removed, the player lifts the balcony, and stacks the block to build the palace on top of the ice wall. Players beware because if the balcony falls at any point during your turn, you are out! The first player to build the ice palace 10 blocks high, and then place the Elsa figure in the balcony, wins.

This Jenga: Downfall Expansion pack includes 10 funky blocks and 30 Downfall cards to add to the Jenga game for an exciting fresh way to play! Players build an epic tower while trying to sabotage each other to get ahead. Take turns drawing cards that tell which block(s) to add to the tower. If a player topples any blocks, they add them to their stash. Certain cards let players swap stashes with others, force a player to stack more blocks, and more. The player with the fewest blocks at the end of the game wins!
This is an expansion. Requires core Jenga game to play.

item.description:
A Nintendo-licensed, Super Mario-themed version of Hasbro's popular block-stacking dexterity game Jenga, with some added twists.
Players choose to play as Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, or Toad, taking a character peg with that character on and slotting it into blocks near the base of the tower. Each turn, a player uses the spinner to determine how many layers up the tower their character peg can climb, and how many blocks they have to remove from the tower and stack on top of it. Blocks are marked with symbols that may cause players to gain or lose coins. Coins can also be gained from climbing the tower or defeating Bowser, who begins at the top of the tower and has to be beaten by climbing past him.
The game ends when someone collapses the tower, at which point the player with the most coins wins.
